sections.title: We know *equestrian properties*

image.alt: A horse standing under overhead heat lamps in a wash stall

body: In about 70 percent of reported barn fires, the confirmed or suspected cause was a malfunctioning heating device or another electrical problem. We design, specify and install barn systems built to take the wear, so your property doesn’t become part of that statistic.
Our maintenance plans include infrared heat scans, cleaning electrical boxes and inspecting conduit and wiring, so pests and wear don’t turn into a fire.
list: Arena lighting for training all year

items.title: Reach out
items.text: Call or email with your project. If it fits our services, we schedule a walkthrough.

items.title: Walkthrough
items.text: Usually 20 to 30 minutes on site. For new construction, we review the plans in detail.

items.title: An accurate estimate
items.text: We gather every detail first, then send a real estimate in a reasonable time.

items.text: Work that meets city regulations and NEC codes, today and at inspection.
